svg.title: H-CELL · Leaf cell
svg.desc: A rectangular leaf cell has a thick outer boundary, an inner boundary, a large pale central region, a smaller oval region to one side, and several green ovals containing stacked marks. Leader B ends inside an upper-right green oval.
